(FOREIGN SECTION)
DATE 1-4-30.
(C.I.D.) Office Notes

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. 4. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 254
Date 1 - 4 - 30

Sir,

Information has been received that Micheal
Parshikoff who was formerly a constable in the S.M.P.
returned to Shanghai on March 25 and is believed
to be residing with his brother in the French Concession.

Parshikoff was tried for murder in the Provisional
Court in June 1927 but was acquitted.

It is also reported that should Parshikoff be
able to collect sufficient funds he will leave
Shanghai.

Wh
1-4-30.

A. Shuhoff.
D. P. B.

A/D. C. I.

REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. J. O. D 254
Foreign Section Station,
Date...21. 6. 29.
Date June 20, 1929

Subject (in full) Sergius Parshekoff.

Made by [illegible] Forwarded by Tho Robertson, C.D.I.

With reference to letter dated June 6, 1929,
from Col. Holland re. Sergius Parshekoff inquiries show that
the latter frequently borrowed money from Indian money-lenders
in Tientsin. It is reported that his only connection with
Teh Singh was in this respect. It is also reported that
Sergius Parshekoff left behind some bills due to Sikh members
of the G. P. S. and often visited Mr. Brackley, owner
and manager of the Acme Advertising Co., Nanking Road.

Sergius Parshekoff left Shanghai to visit his
brother Mikhail Parshekoff, who is seriously ill in Harbin and
since his departure he has sent a letter to Mr. Brackley asking
him to keep his position in the Acme Advertising Co., open as
he intends to return to Shanghai soon. Sergius Parshekoff is
a White Russian and has never come to the notice of the C. I. D.
in connection with Soviet activities.

V. Ovsiannikoff
D. S.

Jule Rea
2/6
V. D. J. I.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记处
编号 J. O. D 254
外籍股分站，
日期...1929年6月21日。
日期 1929年6月20日

主题（全称） Sergius Parshekoff。

由 [字迹不清] 制作 经 Tho Robertson, C.D.I. 转呈

关于1929年6月6日 Holland 上校有关 Sergius Parshekoff 的来信，调查显示后者经常在天津向印度放债人借款。据报道，他与 Teh Singh 的唯一联系即在于此。另据报道，Sergius Parshekoff 留下了一些欠锡克教籍巡捕（G. P. S. 成员）的账单，并经常拜访南京路 Acme 广告公司（Acme Advertising Co.）的所有者兼经理 Brackley 先生。

Sergius Parshekoff 离开上海去哈尔滨探望病重的兄弟 Mikhail Parshekoff，自他离开后，他曾致信 Brackley 先生，请其保留他在 Acme 广告公司的职位，因为他打算不久后返回上海。Sergius Parshekoff 是一名白俄，从未因涉及苏维埃活动而引起刑事侦缉处的注意。

V. Ovsiannikoff
D. S.

Jule Rea
6月2日
V. D. J. I.

（批：A.R. 1929年6月20日）
（批：[签名] 1929年6月21日）

SECRET

H. B. M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai.
6th. June, 1929.

My dear Aiers,

With reference to your letter No. D. 251 dated
the 31st. of May, 1929, I should be grateful if you would kindly
do what you can to obtain information regarding Ishar Singh's
association with Sergius Parshakoff, whose name and address was
found amongst the former's papers. It is possible that the Acme
Advertising Agency might be able to throw some light on the
subject and it would be interesting to find out from them why
Sergius Parshakoff left their employment and departed for Harbin
on the 12th. of May, 1929 - six days after the arrest of Ishar
Singh and the search of his quarters. Has Sergius Parshakoff
ever come to your notice in connection with Soviet activities?

Yours sincerely,

G. H. R. Halkard

R. C. Aiers, Esq.,
Assistant Commissioner of Police,
Criminal Investigation Department,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

（批：A.C.(Pol)

关于您5月24日的来信，调查显示 Sergius Parshekoff 此前居住于霞飞坊109号，是 Mihail Parshekoff 的弟弟。后者曾任工部局警务处巡捕，于1927年2月被控谋杀 Clara Frolova，但该案件已被撤销。

Sergius Parshekoff 于1924年初从符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）抵达上海，并与他的兄弟在北四川路某处同住。作为一名职业画家，他在爱多亚路113号的东方广告代理处（Oriental Advertising Agency）谋得一职。从1926年夏工作至1927年3月10日后，Parshekoff 突然失踪。随后在该公司在静安寺路的广告仓库中发现的一张便条中，他声称对 Clara Frolova 的谋杀案负责的是他而非其兄弟，并表示打算自杀。他还给 Russo, Fisher and Wilhelm 律师事务所的 Wilhelm 博士写了几封内容类似的信件。

1927年7月8日，Sergius Parshekoff 向警方自首，警方据此

Made by D.S. Ovsiannikoff Forwarded by Jhn Robertson C.D.I.

Sir,
With reference to the attached letter from Col. Halland
dated May 24, re Mr. Sergius Parshekoff, inquiries go to show that
the person in question formerly resided at 109 Joffre Terrace
and is a younger brother of ex Constable Mihail Parshekoff of the
Municipal Police, who was charged with the murder of Clara Frolova
in February 1927, the charge against him being dismissed.
Sergius Parsheloff arrived in Shanghai from Vladivostok early
in 1924 and went to live with his brother somewhere in North
Szechuen Road. In the middle of 1926 Sergius Parshekoff, who is
an artist by profession obtained a position with the Oriental
Advertising Agency, 113 Avenue Edward VII until March 10, 1927,
when he suddenly disappeared from Shanghai leaving a note in the
depot of the Advertising Agency in Bubbling Well Road to the
effect that he and not his brother was responsible for the murder
of Clara Frolova and that he intended to commit suicide. He also
wrote several letters on the same subject to Dr. Wilhelm of the
law firm of Messrs. Russo, Fisher and Wilhelm.
On July 5, 1927 Sergius Parshekoff surrendered himself to the
Police, who in consequence of his confessions held a warrant
for his arrest. It was evident however that his confession was made
in order to save his brother and on his appearing in Court the
Police withdrew the charge against him. After his acquittal in the
Provisional Court, Sergius Parsheloff obtained employment in
various capacities in different small Russian shops in Avenue
Joffre, French Concession and latterly was employed by the Acme
Advertising Agency, 64 Peking Road. About one year ago he married
a Russian woman and took up residence at 109 Joffre Terrace as
an employ of the mentioned Company. On May 12, 1929 he and his

先生，
关于随附的 Halland 上校1929年5月24日有关 Sergius Parshekoff 先生的来信，调查显示，此人此前居住于霞飞坊109号，是前工部局警务处巡捕 Mihail Parshekoff 的弟弟，后者曾于1927年2月被控谋杀 Clara Frolova，针对他的指控已被撤销。
Sergius Parsheloff 于1924年初从符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）抵达上海，并与他的兄弟在北四川路某处同住。1926年中，身为职业画家的 Sergius Parshekoff 在爱多亚路113号的东方广告代理处谋得一职，直至1927年3月10日，他突然从上海失踪，并在静安寺路广告代理处的仓库中留下一张便条，称对 Clara Frolova 的谋杀案负责的是他而非其兄弟，并表示打算自杀。他还给 Russo, Fisher and Wilhelm 律师事务所的 Wilhelm 博士写了几封关于同一主题的信件。
1927年7月5日，Sergius Parshekoff 向警方自首，警方因其供词而持有对他的逮捕令。然而，显然他的供认是为了挽救其兄弟，当他出庭时，警方撤销了对他的指控。在临时法庭被判无罪后，Sergius Parsheloff 在法租界霞飞路的各家小型俄国人商店里以各种身份受雇，最近受雇于北京路64号的 Acme 广告代理处。大约一年前，他娶了一位俄国女子，作为上述公司的雇员，入住霞飞坊109号。1929年5月12日，他和他的
